mechanism: Foscarnet can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) and QT prolongation, which combined with escitalopram's dose-dependent QT prolongation risk increases cardiac arrhythmia potential.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes (calcium, magnesium) regularly; consider alternative antivirals if possible or use lowest effective escitalopram dose with baseline and periodic QTc assessment.
